data.title: 砂狼白子 · 沿海公路的破风并肩骑行
data.description: 夏日拂晓的沿海环岛公路，碧蓝的海浪拍打着礁石溅起洁白浪花。白子脚踩专业公路自行车与老师并驾齐驱，贴身骑行服勾勒出没有一丝赘肉的矫健修长身段。晨风拂动她银灰色的短发与灵动狼耳，她侧身望来，冰蓝色的眼眸中闪烁着清澈见底的纯粹喜悦。
data.location: sunlit coastal highway beside sparkling blue ocean
data.action: riding road bicycle, pedaling forward, windblown wolf ears and short hair, refreshing smile
data.lighting: brilliant morning sunshine reflecting off open ocean waters
data.mood: exhilarating athletic freedom, youthful breeze, and seaside joy
data.promptProse: Pedaling swiftly along a sparkling coastal highway beside the ocean, Sunaookami Shiroko smiles with refreshing youth as morning sea breezes ruffle her wolf ears.
data.animaCaption: Shiroko riding her road bike along the sun-drenched coastal highway with a refreshing smile.
